newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil ends near day's high on Iraqi news.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil ends near day's high on Iraqi news.

text.p: IPE September gas oil closed near the day's highs boosted by firmer Brent futures after Iraq accused the United States of blocking implementation of it's oil sales deal with the United Nations, traders said.
"It could be putting the (Iraqi) oil sales back further," one trader commented.
Iraq's deputy U.N. ambassador said on Tuesday that the United States was hindering the implementation of an oil-for-food deal by insisting on too many monitors to supervise the plan.
September gas oil futures last traded 25 cents a tonne off the days high at $189.25 although still $1.75 lower on the day.
The next upside target for the gas oil contract was Friday's low of $190 a tonne.
October Brent crude jumped sharply on the Iraqi news to trade at 1639 GMT, off seven cents on the day at $20.34 a barrel after dipping to a low of $20.11 a barrel earlier.
"It's making a shot at recovery -- even the Americans felt yesterday's losses were overdone," a broker said.
